The method also incorporates a preference HDR computation to generate models that satisfy the preferences. The authors claim that their method is efficient, with sublinear buffer growth and constant training overhead per task. The empirical evaluation of IBCL is conducted on several CL benchmarks, including 20NewsGroup, Split CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and 20NewsGroup again.
